failures.resolution: Separate corrected helper with native argumentOverrides; original helper retained.

failures.resolution: Read-only directory/content diagnostic and separate actual-name proof; no helper rename.

failures.resolution: Saved Python builder; failed attempts preserved.

failures.cause: Existing valid_target_name character allowlist rejects +; digest and size are valid.
failures.resolution: Save/read-back full jobs and SQLite/trust checkpoint, stop Store normally, sign higher role45 with local target alias; do not reset/downgrade trust or rewrite role44.

failures.error: Assumed latestKnownTime dict; actual JSON string caused AttributeError after normal service stop.
failures.resolution: Read-only type-aware verification of inactive Store and exact trust bytes; no dependent mutation at failure.

failures.error: invalid reviewed backend input: catalogue differs from reviewed recipe or cache path
failures.resolution: Catalogue alias must equal installer.fileName in frozen reviewed recipe. New native alias definition installed and full GUI repeated; separately signed alias acceptance at role46, then independent update succeeded. Failed full SQLite row retained.

failures.error: Helper wrongly required whole market snapshot equality despite expected canRollback false-to-true after a fresh second generation.
failures.resolution: Stop dependencies; separately assert exact new Tiled installed state and all old fields/generation records, then save actual checkpoint.

failures.error: Unused market helper contained duplicate save_checkpoint(after-market-install) and copied unrelated original failures.
failures.resolution: Separate corrected helper compiled before market execution, one checkpoint call and market-specific accounting.

failures.error: Some guessed helper paths and Windows literal glob searches failed.
failures.resolution: rg --files/-g and verified actual paths; no runtime mutation caused.

failures.error: Initial *.png glob included the synthetic tiles.png input image and failed expected 21-screenshot assertion after copying new screenshots.
failures.resolution: Separate numbered screenshots from input image and preserve initial helper; no screenshots deleted or overwritten.

limitations: Only two distinct small Chinese-name 4x4 finite orthogonal one-layer input maps with two synthetic tiles were tested: erase one red tile, stamp green tiles at (1,1) and (2,2), GUI Save As TMX to ASCII path, GUI JSON export and explicit new-process rendering of both saved formats. Each input is 515 bytes; TMX output 548 bytes, JSON output 947 bytes. Original and market inputs remain exact bytes. The same original fixture was repeated in the alias formal generation; neither fixtures nor repeat generations count as applications.

Infinite/isometric/hexagonal maps, multiple/object layers, terrain/automapping, animations, projects/worlds, engine integration, large maps, broad export/plugin formats, direct Chinese keyboard input and advanced editor features were not verified.

A local filename alias replaces upstream + with plus in the signed catalogue target and newly frozen installer definition only. Official download URL and upstream filename retain +, identical package bytes/SHA/size are checked. No Core code, launcher environment, working directory, fonts, global runtime context, program/DLL or runtime bytes were changed. Original definition/generation and all original GUI/source/signature receipts remain historical bytes.

The official release API asset digest was null. HTTPS downloaded bytes have a self-computed SHA-256 and matching published API asset size; no upstream digest, Authenticode, OpenPGP or reproducible build verification is claimed. Version 1.11.2 is pinned, not claimed latest.

Main program GPL-2.0-or-later is declared in fixed source src/tiled/mainwindow.cpp. Installed COPYING.txt, LICENSE.GPL.txt and LICENSE.BSD.txt exactly match selected fixed source bytes (CRLF normalization count zero). Full Qt, plugins, example assets, engine formats and bundled licence closure was not verified.

Same-version update uses verified pre-cache and Store IPC; rollback uses Store IPC. GUI update/rollback buttons, guest network download, fresh-machine recipe registration, configuration migration, cross-version upgrade and unattended startup were not verified. Network deny in a launch plan is not claimed actual enforced network isolation.

Preservation checks cover all full Core jobs and Store SQLite rows/fields, all generation records, config/trust/guards, prior fixed acceptance data, three Tiled generations installed-file hashes and new fixed map/program/licence/config/registry data. They do not enumerate all filesystem data of all previously tested applications.
